what.q: O que é o INTGETION JOB LIST?
what.a: Um agregador de vagas remotas e de eventos Web3 e tech. Procure vagas, encontre cúpulas e meetups para fazer networking e deixe o assistente Spoki sugerir o que combina com o seu perfil.

free.a: Sim. Pesquisar, se candidatar e publicar vagas é gratuito. Os planos pagos trazem mais velocidade e alcance — veja Preços.

apply.a: Abra uma vaga e toque em Candidatar-se. Nas vagas importadas, a candidatura é feita no site do próprio empregador.

post.a: Toque em Publicar vaga, entre e preencha o formulário. A vaga aparece no feed após a revisão.

capabilities.lead: Selected work — systems shipped or piloted.

items.title: Lead intake instead of a group chat
items.text: A small service team took inbound from Instagram, Telegram and manual forwards. Qualification lived in one manager’s head — warm leads died overnight. Built one intake path (form / Telegram → table → status: new / qualified / call / dead), short qualification rules, and an owner ping if no reply in 12 working hours. Weekly review of why a lead died — not a vanity report.
items.stack: Telegram bot · spreadsheet / Notion · webhooks · first-reply templates
items.outcome: First reply from “whenever someone remembered” to under 2 hours on working days. Lost warm leads in a month: 8 → 2. Qualified calls: +6 on the same traffic.

items.title: Research queue with a human in the loop
items.text: Company cards were assembled by hand: site, socials, offer, “do we write?”. 25–40 minutes per card — sales waited on research. Built: domain list → public pages → short card (offer, geo, do-not-contact signals) → human accept / edit / reject. Rejected cards never reach outreach.
items.stack: Python · LLM via OpenRouter · light RAG / saved pages · Notion as the card queue
items.outcome: Card time ~35 min → ~8 min with review. 120 companies in the pilot, 18 dropped before the first message. No send without review.

items.title: Delivery pipeline for a 4-person team
items.text: Traffic, design, account, sales. Tasks lived in Telegram; “yesterday” was the default deadline — the owner could not see whether the bottleneck was sales or delivery. Built one deal pipeline: lead → proposal → delivery → done. Each stage has one owner and one artifact. Weekly review of three numbers only: new qualified, deals in progress, overdue tasks. Backlog separated from on-fire work. Telegram is an alert, not the database.
items.stack: Notion (or Linear) · brief templates · Telegram alerts
items.outcome: Overdue tasks at week-end: 11 → 3. Time from payment to work start: 5–6 days → 2 days. Account stopped being the only project memory.
